summary: Chat 4 Shared UI promotion is lane-complete and ready for integration/handoff. The required five-file shard reconciles all 70 Shared UI census targets with zero loss. Read-only drift evaluation shows current main advanced to d08013db42c34ccafb80075392ec6d7a289cf7b5 only through the new status-channel coordination layer plus global FILES_MANIFEST maintenance; no Shared UI candidate path or underlying Shared UI visual authority/evidence path used by Chat 4 was changed. No lane regeneration or rebase is justified. A separate global FILES_MANIFEST integration remains outside Chat 4 authority.

blockers.detail: PRISMA VISCORE1 Certification fails only at 'Committed file manifest must already match'. prisma-html/tools/refresh_files_manifest.py inventories the five new prisma-html lane files, but the Chat 4 worker contract forbids writes to global FILES_MANIFEST.json, its generator, workflow, or other lanes. This does not invalidate lane handoff readiness.

All 70 records retain truthful semantic/application blockers such as exact-binding, layer-application-policy, recipe and semantic. 19 targets have no exact RIFAT region row and 11 have multiple candidate region rows. These are promotion readiness facts, not permission for Chat 4 to repair global authority.

No exact existing NDC binding was proven for any of the 70 physical targets; all ndcResolutionStatus values remain UNRESOLVED and no canonical NDC IDs were invented.

Identity Shared UI is a NEUTRAL_SOURCE and its existing neutral binding definitions are blocked by missing concrete surface binding authority; no exact existing binding was claimed for these physical targets.
Projection evidence is CURRENT for all 70 exact-byte-copy source/output pairs.
Consumer references in Tablet, PC and Mobile were recorded as evidence only; no consumer files were edited.
Current main is d08013db42c34ccafb80075392ec6d7a289cf7b5 while the immutable lane base remains 57b01ad8bda043ec25763203354b686341bace09.

Base-to-current-main compare is 3 commits ahead and changes only coordination/status artifacts, AGENTS.md, the visual-promotion shared docs/vocabulary with status-channel additions, and prisma-html/FILES_MANIFEST.json maintenance. It does not touch prisma-html/governance/visual-promotion/candidates/shared-ui/**, Shared UI Target Index/expanded evidence, Shared UI Identity adapter/bindings, NDC source registries used, Atlasfin registries used, or the Shared UI projection manifest.
The new shared-contract changes add status-channel reporting as a coordination-only write exception; they do not grant new lane mutation authority or alter Chat 4 candidate ownership.
